entities.name: Breathstealers
entities.description: An ancient cult of fanatical religious assassins and nightstalkers from Urborg organized into five major clans.

entities.name: Spirit of the Night
entities.description: Dreaded demon spirit summoned by the Breathstealers, which killed the Femeref Council of Voices.

entities.name: Femeref Council of Voices
entities.description: Council killed by the Spirit of the Night.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: Dark mage the Breathstealers aided in conquering Jamuraa.

entities.name: Vizier Qhattib
entities.description: Vizier of Amiqat killed by the Breathstealers.

entities.name: Mirage War
entities.description: War after which the Breathstealers infiltrated Suq'Atan society.
